steps: Verify frozen selection SHA-256 and exact catalogue signature hash.
Copy exact catalogue fields and governed subject identity into a candidate specification.
Mark only an identically named required parameter 'subject' as resolved from frozen subject identity.
Carry catalogue scope, temporal, evidence, and missingness constraints without promoting them to concrete values.
List every remaining required parameter and required concrete proposition/referent/join/operation/time as unresolved.
Compute candidate identity from the complete candidate bytes.
Reject v1.4 request lowering unless all material fields are independently bound and a new frozen specification identity is issued.
